title: Iterated derivatives from a derivative recurrence on an open set
statement: Let U⊆ℂ be open, n∈ℕ, Q : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ, and g : ℂ → ℂ. Suppose that for every r<n and z∈U, Q_r has complex derivative −Q_{r+1}(z) at z, and that for every z∈U, Q_n has complex derivative g(z) at z. Then for every z∈U, iteratedDeriv (n+1) Q_0 z = (−1)^n g(z). No assumptions are imposed outside U.
lean_statement: ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Q : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen U → (∀ (r : ℕ), r < n → ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (Q r) (-Q (r + 1) z) z) → (∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (Q n) (g z) z) → ∀ z ∈ U, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (Q 0) z = (-1 : ℂ) ^ n * g z
